description: Listening approvals a human gave OUTSIDE the studio's sign-off form: before the studio existed (kind 'before_studio': pilot_v1, wave2_batch1_v1) and later, stated by the project owner in chat and recorded here by an agent (kind 'owner_statement': wave2_batch2_v1 to wave2_batch4_v1, branches_v1, modes_v1 and characters_v1). Read by the studio's Review tab and shown as 'approved before the studio / by record', distinct from a sign-off made in the studio's form. An agent only transcribes what the human said; it never approves. This file is a record, not a gate: a master whose sha256 differs from `master_sha256` is NOT covered and waits for a fresh listening. master_sha256 is the hash of each master in the commit that added that approval. The packs' own evidence.json files keep `human_listening: pending` on purpose (rewriting them would change pack hashes); this file is the record of the listening.
